scope: Read-only validation of existing live package evidence supplied by parent; no new live probes or mutations.
liveServiceEvidence: Parent confirmed active Dovecot IMAP+LMTP and public25/587/993. Delivery plus later IMAP parsing matches the advisory path. SMTP25/587 are delivery context, not asserted to be Dovecot listeners.
classification: Older disclosure, newly relevant confirmed package exposure; availability risk.
prerequisite: Attacker can deliver mail to a user; message headers contain very many email addresses or MIME parameters, and Dovecot later parses it over IMAP. No attacker mailbox credentials required by this CVE.
impact: Memory exhaustion terminates the IMAP process, denying service for the affected user; this CVE is not a demonstrated remote-code-execution issue.
vendorExploitStatus: Vendor advisory reports no publicly available exploits known; no fresh exploitation validation was performed.
priorityJudgment: Lead confirmed operational exposures because an active mail service and public mail delivery match the unauthenticated message-input path. Keep separate from new-this-week announcements and from condition-dependent desktop API issues.
remediationCaveat: Updating to bookworm deb12u6 alone does not close this CVE according to the current Debian tracker. Need a vendor-supported package carrying the complete fix, or an explicitly verified backport; do not silently treat Dovecot Pro2.3.22.2 as a Debian CE package floor.
